# Tailwind — Kimox Studio conventions

**Tailwind v4.** That is the decision; the repos have not caught up with it.

| | today |
|---|---|
| `rachafit` | v4 — the target |
| `characters-vault/apps/webapp` | v4 |
| `alea-webapp` | v3, `tailwind.config.ts` |
| `characters-vault/apps/web` | v2 — legacy, Pages Router |
| `kimoxstudio.com` | no Tailwind at all, hand-written CSS |

A v3→v4 move rewrites the config into CSS and touches every file using a
customised token: a migration, see `kx-standards`.

Until a project has migrated, write what that project uses. Read its config
before the first line of styling.

## v4: config lives in CSS

No `tailwind.config.ts`. Import Tailwind and declare tokens in the stylesheet:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";

@theme {
  --color-surface: …;
  --color-accent: …;
}
```

## Tokens are semantic

Both v4 projects name tokens by role, not by colour: `--surface`, `--text`,
`--accent`, `--accent-ink`, `--warn`, `--danger`. Neither has a `blue-500`
anywhere.

A component asks for `--surface`, not for the colour that happens to be the
surface today. That is what makes a theme switch a stylesheet change instead of
a find-and-replace.

**No arbitrary values.** `p-[13px]` and `text-[#3b82f6]` mean the scale did not
have what you needed, and the answer is a token, not an escape hatch. `rachafit`
has none. Also see `kx-design`, whose spacing and type scales are the reason a
value off the scale is a defect rather than a preference.

## Dark mode by `data-theme`

Two of the three projects switch themes by redefining variables under a
`data-theme` attribute, and the CSS cascade does the rest:

```css
:root                  { --accent-ink: var(--accent); }
[data-theme="light"]   { --accent-ink: #556e00; }
```

Components never carry `dark:` variants. `alea-webapp` uses `dark:` because it
is on v3 with `darkMode: ['class']`; that is the older setup, not the target.

## Variants

`alea-webapp` uses **CVA** plus a `cn()` helper (`clsx` + `tailwind-merge`);
`rachafit` extracts `@apply` classes into `globals.css` and composes suffixes
(`.btn--primary`). `characters-vault/apps/webapp` hand-writes utilities and
keeps `tailwind-merge` around.

**Unsettled.** Three projects, three answers, and no decision has been made.
Follow the repo you are in, and do not introduce CVA into a repo using `@apply`
or the reverse.

What is settled: when a component takes a `className` prop and merges it, it
goes through `tailwind-merge`. Concatenating class strings by hand produces
`p-2 p-4` and the loser is whichever Tailwind emitted first.

## Responsive

Mobile-first, standard breakpoints. `kimoxstudio.com` sizes type with
`clamp()` rather than breakpoints — worth copying for display text, where a
fluid scale beats three discrete jumps.

No container queries anywhere yet.
